reviews.title: Plays Phantom Music
reviews.text: I thought this was app was going to be great after they took Musi away. However it’s proving to be extremely annoying. Even if the app isn’t open, for some reason, it still plays music. This has happened multiple times. My phone will start blasting music out of nowhere and it’s very embarrassing when it happens in public. It also has a weird habit of only playing three songs on repeat even if I pressed on my recently played, which has a lot more than three songs. I’m not sure if I’m the only one having these issues, but I’m looking for another music app.

reviews.title: Good enough
reviews.text: Pretty good alternative to Musi, but it strongly needs some quality of life improvements. There is a 50%-100% chance that a song will play twice rather than go on to the next song normally. When manually selecting a song to play rather than just putting a playlist on shuffle, there’s a high chance that for whatever reason the app will refuse to play the song, skipping to the next one without even attempting to load the one you wanted. Closing out of the app and reopening fixes it. When an ad plays, it’s not muted by default. Swiping out of the app while an ad is playing prevents the music from playing in the background like it normally should. These aren’t one off bugs I’ve found, these are daily reoccurring issues. It comes together to make a pretty frustrating experience. Once these things are fixed, though, this is a perfect app.

reviews.title: Its getting worse..
reviews.text:
I don’t know why the devs are just ignoring all the complaints, but it’s getting so unreliable, and poor. I get they want adds to make money, but why is it getting slow and buggy? It’s like the government is trying to shut down, and force ppl out of any good, free music apps, so don’t bother anymore i guess, the devs are no longer in control. 
The bugs I’m currently experiencing is that no-internet playback barely works anymore. It used to be fine, but now it shuts off after every song, even on autoplay, and thats if i ever get it to recognise it needs to play music in the first place. Also, for me they’ve never worked, but pre-made playlists are completely broken, and always have been, i hope they can fix them, then this app would be slightly better.

reviews.title: Insanely Buggy
reviews.text: Downloaded because Musi was taking off the App Store and at 1st the app worked perfectly fine, but after a year having used it, it genuinely is so buggy and outdated. Certain songs will not play at all regardless of how good your service connection is or if you have the song in playlists already. Randomly the app not allow you to look at a full album playlist even if connected to WiFi. And if you try to back up your playlist when switching phones only a small portion of the songs you have saved and some playlist will be salvaged. Whoever designed this app honestly did so poorly.  Please fix the issues otherwise this app will genuinely die out.

reviews.title: i need musi back asap.
reviews.text: I have to use this app due to the takedown of Musi, which, ill give the Devil its due, it has the same layout. BUT. It's extremely unreliable, and FINNICKY!!!! Theres obviously ads, which usually i wouldn't mind, if the MUSIC would play without me having to go through the entire ad, and wasting my time. There are times where it will STOP PLAYING unless you watch the ad and close it. It's extremely annoying if you are in a scenario where you cannot reach your phone. And there are times where it wont come up in the mini player thing so you CANNOT PAUSE IT!!!!!!! Another thing, musi's ads were SILENT in background play, not musicana. You have to close the app, or else it will play alongside your music. WHO WANTS THAT? it is constantly in-and-out. I have to deal with this app while i wait for music to come back.

reviews.title: Ok app but Musi was better
reviews.text:
Couple problems I cannot get over. 
1. When you skip forward a song, then go backwards, that song you initially landed on is now gone and has shuffled to another song

3. Small issue here; Once I disconnect phone from car, the song keeps playing on my phone. So when i turn my car off, the app will autoplay the song when i never pressed play.
